scope: Current-source tests, explicit installed SDK admission, fresh x86_64 SDK integration, selected actual single-CPU QEMU guests. No physical or manual desktop acceptance.

milestones.name: Contracts and evidence ledger
milestones.fresh_evidence: Schema, SDK admission and 97 related controls pass; full gate-m0 fails.
milestones.remaining: Seed inventory, four reviewed normative indexes, source/requirement/test mappings and complete evidence closure are missing.

milestones.name: Allocation, VM, waits and time
milestones.fresh_evidence: Hosted allocator/mapping/wait controls pass; actual x86_64 native time/poll/private VM and paged VM markers pass before a later quota-test failure.
milestones.remaining: General allocation/reclaim/OOM/VM and sustained pressure qualification are incomplete. POSIX pressure fixture and ABI55 object-pressure admission are broken.

milestones.name: Paths, files, credentials and IPC
milestones.fresh_evidence: Hosted VFS/UNIX/PTY/console ownership controls pass; actual shell pipes, namespace operations and links pass.
milestones.remaining: Complete path/mount/race semantics, independent PTY session/foreground authority, termios and broad IPC failure handling remain open.

milestones.name: Native ABI and libc substrate
milestones.fresh_evidence: ABI, signal, futex, thread and wrapper controls pass apart from stale harnesses; native applications execute fork/exec/wait paths.
milestones.remaining: No complete libc/pthread/cancellation or all-profile native musl acceptance; no new claim of full POSIX conformance.

milestones.name: Durable root filesystem
milestones.fresh_evidence: Fresh ext4 consumers build; bounded native save/sync/host-retire/restart and offline fsck are tested; hosted ext4/JBD2 paths pass.
milestones.remaining: Default general journalled root, metadata/cache/request ownership and crash/volatile-cache-loss/FLUSH qualification remain open.

milestones.name: User environment
milestones.fresh_evidence: Actual release shell pipelines, Notes and basic utilities are tested; hosted shell/shared-loader controls pass.
milestones.remaining: General shell scripts/expansion/jobs, shared mappings/cache, shared loader/TLS/dlopen/cancellation and ports breadth remain open. Full SimpleFS staging fails.

milestones.name: Networking
milestones.fresh_evidence: Actual x86_64 PCI and aarch64 MMIO Virtio static ARP/IPv4/UDP campaigns pass exchange/hostile/absent/legacy scenarios.
milestones.remaining: Reliable general TCP/IPv6, IRQ networking, configuration/DNS/HTTP/TLS and loss/reordering/pressure acceptance remain open.

milestones.name: PID1, accounts and services
milestones.fresh_evidence: Hosted account, authenticated-control, service lifecycle, logging, time, resolver, mount and shutdown policy controls pass. Basic native PID1 launches tested maintenance shells.
milestones.remaining: Authenticated account login and orderly reboot/poweroff campaigns were not rerun here; general session authority, graphical login and full system services remain open.

milestones.name: Isolated graphics
milestones.fresh_evidence: Files/Notes/handoff hosted ASan+UBSan checks pass; privileged GUI boot is present.
milestones.remaining: Separate user compositor and clients, protected display buffers, input ownership, toolkit/fonts/Wayland and isolated PTY terminal execution remain open.

milestones.name: Daily desktop
milestones.fresh_evidence: Notes actual-source host file/fault controls and real native command-line save/read workflows pass where listed below.
milestones.remaining: Unprivileged GUI applications and complete login/network/package/installer/recovery/accessibility/UTF-8-CJK/lock workflows remain open.

milestones.name: Ext4 feature breadth
milestones.fresh_evidence: Bounded supported ext4 operations, block sizes, format refusal and offline interoperability are tested.
milestones.remaining: Every advertised feature/combination and read/write/replay profile is not qualified; stat hardlink-oracle construction currently fails.

milestones.name: Architecture, SMP and device breadth
milestones.fresh_evidence: All ten current-source standalone Debug kernels build and boot in QEMU; all twenty installed SDKs pass admission.
milestones.remaining: Single-CPU boot/model records do not establish concurrent SMP/TLB/IRQ/DMA/hotplug or actual module relocation/execution/unload. Physical machines were not tested.

milestones.name: Complete workstation/release target
milestones.fresh_evidence: Fresh x86_64 Debug/Release SDK export and selected consumer builds are verified with preserved failures and artifacts.
milestones.remaining: Mandatory ledger closure, complete release/recovery and manual desktop acceptance remain open.

findings.summary: Full rootfs staging contains 36 files but SimpleFS accepts at most 32. Fresh x86_64 Debug/Release and three other Debug consumers reproduce failure. Existing archive unit tests deliberately expect full-staging rejection.

POSIX second_pressure allocation fails with ENOMEM on fresh x86_64 Debug/Release and installed-SDK aarch64 Debug. Current user quota is 661 pages; two requested 384-page mappings alone require 768, before existing user pages. Earlier native private-VM/time/poll checks pass. This does not establish allocator corruption.
Object pressure calls the shared ABI74 SDK validator and then requires ABI55. Its 27-method module has one failure and one error; the current qualifier cannot admit a current SDK.
Documented whole-suite unittest discovery aborts because tools/test_native_users.py shadows tests/tools/test_native_users.py. Per-module processes recover coverage.
Standalone Linux-stat oracle intentionally stages hard links, but the current composed-root policy rejects aliased inodes; failure occurs before guest stat execution.
Static dispatch tests copy BasicScheduler after ownership members made it noncopyable; the first i386 hosted profile does not compile.

findings.kind: two stale hosted runner input sets
findings.summary: scheduler_waits and thread_lifecycle snapshots omit scheduler .inc files and current memory/UDP/VFS link dependencies. Official entrypoints fail. Separate diagnostic harnesses using unchanged current dependencies pass 9487 and 3206 x86_64 checks; canonical runners remain unfixed.
kernel_services runner omits terminal_power.cpp and its execution stub lacks enter_owned. Normal standalone kernels build, but this regression entrypoint cannot link.
